segments.text: So, this vṛti on shūsūtras has been put before readers, which is this vṛti, which
is beautified by being attached with agamā, with the references of agamas, say, agam
samvād, spandas, and the reference of spandas.
Spandas' astra is also referred here, and agamā is also referred here.
So, it has become beautified by these two ways of reference, collection of both.
So, let those fortunate souls, fortunate readers, fortunate persons,
rāsī and thū, taste, māsūtulun kāsa-gavangrīs, but relish the nectar of shūsūtra
emershī, the commentary of mind, for the sake of destroying the different-sated perception
of universe, bhavas-chidē, for the sake of destroying the different-sated perception
of universe. And which is, that shūsūtra emershī, which is flowing out, which flows out,
shū rāsī, the secret of Shiva, and which is filled with the always, always newly existing nectar,
and it is essence. Now, our Amrita-sāra-rasa-ulānām, ulānām paripūrām, brahmītām, that this
is the glory of this commentary of shūsūtras, of mind, is this power, that O Ōchikinām
Ruchvārdini, those who are not, who are not, who have no curiosity to see this, to realize
this shavism, your curiosity is created in their minds by reading this shūsūtra emershī,
who are, yes, parinatīm tanute parma mathe, and mathe parma parinatīm tanute, and it expands
the great change of intellect, intellect, one's intellect, intellect gets great change in them.
Rasāna-mātrati, by only testing it, releasing it, so, just like the flow of character, it removes
away the fear of birth and death and old age, birth, death and old age. The fear of birth, death
and old age is over. Deha, prāna, sukhādībi, parīmitā, hā, hantās, padai, samrta, chahitānyam,
chunute, nijam, nasumahād, mahe, sharam, sumjana, madhī, bohda, sudhāv, divi, shama,
bītās, tathēnepindu, pamam, yāpāshētubhade, shētās, tukkājitā, sākśāk, sēkā, sivam.
This ordinary public, ordinary people, do not perceive the original state of their God-consciousness,
which is great and which belongs to Lord Shiva himself, because their consciousness is concealed.
Their consciousness is concealed by the, by adjustment of ego on a limited, deh, prāna and sukhādī,
limited, deh, prāmadhībhā, prāna prāmadhībhā, and puristak prāmadhībhā. Their consciousness is
concealed by that, by this ego. And when madhībhā, bohda, sudhāv, divi, shama, abhita, sathēnepindu,
pamam, yāpāshētubhade, and that rare soul, rare soul, who by the opadeśa, by the teaching of
Shiva sathur yumarshenī, the man who realizes that this whole universe is nothing, only existing,
existing, you know, calculated form in the ocean of nectar, in the ocean of universal,
nectar of universal consciousness. This is only form, calculated form. There's nothing, no other than that.
You know, form, what is form? Yes, yes. Sākṣāsa, ekāshivaḥ kajata, he is one with Shiva, he has become one with Lord Shiva.
Upadeśa, by the teaching of this Shiva sathur yumarshenī, the man who realizes that this whole universe is nothing,
sākṣārav, divi, dāte, parē, padē, padamāvi, jālām, nitya, loho, ka pramod, sunir, parē,
yumarshenī, the man who realizes that this whole universe is nothing, only existing,
existing, you know, calculated form in the ocean of universal consciousness.
Sākṣāsa, mūtpala veda, yitāti, tārta tārta sākṣārav, divi, o fortunate ones, o fortunate ones,
that you cross this ocean of samsāra immediately and put your foot, put your establishment
and be established in the state of supreme state of Lord God consciousness and be fixed your foot there.
Padamāvi, jālām, veda, jālām, without movement, which is the God consciousness,
which is filled with the nectar of eternal prakāśya, nitya, loho, ka, eternal prakāśya.
And at the same time, rāyaśya samujalam, sutram, śūproktam, yumarshata,
this sutra, which has come out from the lips of Lord Shiva, which is shining with the real
secret of His being, rāyaśya samujalam, prasadu, yelasat, sākyu, jānta, sāmūtpala veda, yitā,
that sutra will make you cross over this differentiated universal perception in no time,
by the yukti, by the trick of your master.
Yit shīmahāma, hi, shirā āchāri, variyābhina, ugūtpāda, padmūtpāda, upijīv irsī, kamrājiv irjitāyām,
shūsūtruv yumarshinyām, anūv pāya prakāśya samujāmā, nitya, nitya.
So, there ends shūtruv yumarshinyām.
